failed_probe.corrective_action: The run aborted at the first periodic safety check. All six Torque_Enable registers were then explicitly written to 0 and read back as 0 before the replacement run.
failed_probe.finding: On this physical STS3215 set, broadcasting Goal_Position while torque is disabled cannot be treated as a torque-off no-op: all six Torque_Enable registers subsequently read 1.

test.transaction: one six-servo broadcast SYNC_WRITE of the two-byte SRAM Goal_Time register; frame length matches the production Goal_Position SYNC_WRITE

decision: Keep the existing 15 ms value. It is more conservative than the isolated static formula candidate. Response level 1 provides no device acknowledgement, and the prior mixed read/write path has unresolved timeouts and torque-state behavior, so reducing the configured write budget is unsupported.
scope_limit: This verifies host-side submission timing for an equal-length, no-op two-byte SRAM SYNC_WRITE under unloaded torque-off static conditions. It does not prove device receipt, Goal_Position behavior, active-motion timing, USB drain latency, or mixed read/write recovery semantics.
